description.en: Southern coastal plain around Jaffa and Ascalon.
description.ar: السهل الساحلي الجنوبي حول يافا وعسقلان.
description.he: מישור החוף הדרומי סביב יפו ואשקלון.

sources.quote: included four great baronies: the county of Jaffa and Ascalon, the lordship of Krak or Montréal, the principality of Galilee, and the lordship of Sidon.
Captured by the Crusaders after a 50-year struggle (1153), it became one of their principal ports and strongholds.
On the 19th of August, 1153, a three days' truce was proclaimed. The inhabitants left so speedily that, two days later, Ascalon was empty.
The government of Ascalon was entrusted to Amalric, count of Jaffa, the king's brother.
all the major ports south of Tripoli, with the exception of Tyre, were in Moslem hands. These included Beirut, Jaffa, Ascalon, and Sidon
